title: Private Well Recovery after an Emergency
description: CDC's May 2025 text-only guidance for private wells after emergencies, including flood and electrical hazards, well disinfection, and follow-up testing. CDC advises contacting local authorities and a qualified well or pump contractor. Fuel or toxic chemical contamination is not made safe by boiling or disinfection. This is a text rendition, not a substitute for current local guidance.
